model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of two models—Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY—on easy and hard training sets, respectively, over 500 steps. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps," which ranges from 0 to 500 with a linear scale and tick marks every 100 steps. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Training Rewards," ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, also with linear scales and tick marks at regular intervals. In the top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," the blue line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) and red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) both start near 0.0 and increase steadily, with the red line slightly surpassing the blue line after approximately 100 steps. By step 500, both lines stabilize around 0.35–0.40, with the red line consistently higher than the blue line, and both are shaded with light bands indicating variability. In the bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," the blue line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) rises initially but drops to near 0.0 after about 100 steps and remains flat. The red line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) increases steadily from 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, with some fluctuations, and is shaded with a light band indicating variability.
